bonus.title: BONUS SYSTEM
bonus.p1: a bonus system is available for registered users in the online store. When purchasing a product, the buyer is awarded bonus points that can be spent on the next purchase.
earningRules: The bonus system allows accumulating points by purchasing eligible products.

The purchase must be made from the website or the app. Calculation occurs only after the order gets 'Completed' status, i.e., after meeting all delivery and payment conditions. Please note that regional delivery takes some time, so points will be credited shortly after.
Points are awarded only to users registered before purchasing. The amount of accumulated points can be tracked in the 'Account'.
The bonus system currently does not apply to discounted items.
bonus.note: The bonus program does not apply to all products! Products eligible for points are marked with a corresponding icon next to the price.
usingRules: You can only spend points when purchasing from app version v.1.2.0 or higher (available on AppStore or GooglePlay).
Currently, you can spend points on any product, regardless of whether there is a discount or not.
Points cannot be refunded as cash or used directly in the retail store.
Points must not exceed 50% of the total order amount.
bonus.example1: For example, if you accumulated 100 points and want to buy an order worth 100 manats, you can cover 50 manats with points, and pay the rest in cash.
bonus.example2: If you accumulated 100 points and bought a product for 200 manats, you can spend all 100 points for this order, and the remaining amount must be paid in cash or by card online upon delivery.

delivery.title: DELIVERY AND PAYMENT
delivery.p1: You can pick up your order yourself from the shop at A. Niyazov (Hudayberdiyev) street, building 99, by calling the shop assistants in advance.
delivery.p2_1: Delivery within Ashgabat is carried out during the day or the next day (depending on the order time). If the order exceeds 500 manats, delivery is free (delivery cost – 20 manats). Delivery to remote areas is free, but only if the order is over 1000 manats (delivery cost – 50 manats).
delivery.p2_2: Delivery in Ashgabat is carried out between 09:00 and 19:00.
delivery.workTimeValue: every day from 09:30 to 18:30, Sunday from 11:00 to 19:00.
delivery.p3_1: Delivery to regions is carried out by the postal service of Turkmenistan. The delivery time is 2-5 days on average. More time may be required for the delivery of goods ordered on holidays or weekends. When ordering anywhere in Turkmenistan from the website, delivery is free, but the order must exceed 1500 manats (delivery cost – 50 manats). When placing an order, we request you to fill in the data accurately, if the address and city do not match, the goods will not be sent until the order is re-registered.
delivery.p3_2: If the above delivery methods do not meet the customer's requirements, the Customer has the right to suggest their own method, in which case the customer assumes full responsibility for the safety of the goods and delivery costs.
delivery.p3_3: After placing an order, our assistant will contact you by phone to clarify some details. If the phone is unavailable during the day, the order will be canceled.
delivery.paymentText: Payment can be made through the following methods:
paymentMethods: Bank card (payment via terminal upon self-pickup and delivery within Ashgabat);
Online payment (please note that online payment does not work when using VPN and various proxy servers);
Non-cash payment (transfer of funds through the bank for legal entities and enterprises, we provide the possibility of payment to a foreign currency account for foreign companies);
